🎬 Clara’s Heart (1988)

Clara’s Heart follows David Hart, a young boy whose comfortable family life begins falling apart after the tragic loss of his baby sister leaves his parents struggling with grief and their increasingly troubled marriage. Feeling lonely and emotionally disconnected from his family, David finds unexpected comfort when Clara Mayfield, a warmhearted Jamaican woman, is hired to work as a housekeeper in their Baltimore home. With her strong personality, wisdom, and compassionate nature, Clara gradually becomes an important presence in David’s life, offering him the understanding and emotional support he desperately needs. As their friendship grows, David begins to see Clara as more than an employee, discovering a meaningful connection that helps him cope with the changes happening around him. However, Clara carries painful secrets from her own past, and her reluctance to discuss them creates tension as David becomes determined to understand the woman who has transformed his life. Through heartfelt conversations, difficult family moments, and emotional revelations, both David and Clara confront grief, loneliness, and the importance of learning to trust others. As their relationship deepens, they discover that friendship and compassion can help heal even the most painful experiences. Combining touching drama, memorable performances, and emotional storytelling, the film explores family, loss, friendship, forgiveness, and the extraordinary bonds that can develop between people from different backgrounds.

🎭 Genre: Drama • Family

⭐ IMDb: 6.2/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 48m • PG-13

🎥 Director: Robert Mulligan
